name: @jixo/opendweb-client-sdk
description: @jixo/opendweb-client-sdk — dweb application-level fabric SDK for Node (napi-rs binding)

scripts.build:win: PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" LIBNODE_PATH="$HOME/libnode-win" cargo build --release --target x86_64-pc-windows-gnu -p dweb-client-sdk && cp "$HOME/.cargo-target/dweb/x86_64-pc-windows-gnu/release/dweb_client_sdk.dll" dweb.win32-x64.node
